description: Daily step counts plotted against a labeled dashed goal line at 10,000 steps.
overview: Daily steps as a line with dots, plotted against a labeled dashed goal line. Use it when a single target gives the values their meaning, such as quotas, budgets or fitness goals.
usage: Replace `chartData` and set `GOAL` to your target. Change the label text on the `ReferenceLine` and the unit in the tooltip formatter and axis `tickFormatter` to match your metric.
notes: The value axis scales to the data only, so a goal far above or below every value may fall outside the plot; set a `domain` on the axis if that can happen. Focus the chart and use the arrow keys to step through the days.
